blindness_attestation.scope: Only the frozen strategy, review contract, pinned Job WEB text, and pinned Job Hebrew witnesses informed this proposal.

method.speaker_policy: Explicit formulas govern; no missing speaker is supplied and Job 28 stays speaker-ambiguous.
method.source_policy: WEB coordinates define coverage; OSHB and UXLC are correlated evidence views, not reading or boundary authority.
method.hydration_policy: Every child retains named speech, exchange or cycle, and prose-frame context.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: The narrator completes character, household, feast cycle, and habitual offerings before the new heavenly-day scene at 1:6.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject 1:1-12; earthly iterative portrait and heavenly council differ in setting, actors, and narrative time.
units.counterevidence: The accusation depends on the blameless-upright portrait, so the whole 1:1-2:13 frame must hydrate it.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate the first council and whole prose trial frame.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: The council day develops accusation and counterclaim and closes with bounded permission and the adversary's exit before calamity at 1:13.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject ending at 1:11; 1:12 is the ruling and exit that resolves the exchange.
units.counterevidence: Permission is realized at once in 1:13-22, so the catastrophe sibling is required.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Four while-he-was-still-speaking reports crescendo in the children's deaths, then mourning, worship, speech, and narrator verdict close the first test.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject isolating 1:20-22; Job's response is the literary result of the catastrophe cascade.
units.counterevidence: Each report could be staged alone, but repetition makes one accelerating sequence.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Again on the council day restages the exchange, cites retained integrity, escalates to Job's body, and ends with a life-preserving limit.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject merging with 1:6-12; the first earthly test intervenes and this repeated scene authorizes a distinct escalation.
units.counterevidence: Near-verbatim repetition binds both councils as parallel scenes within one frame.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate the first council and first integrity response.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: The adversary inflicts sores, Job assumes the ash-heap posture, the wife's imperative elicits Job's answer, and the narrator evaluates his speech.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject isolating 2:9-10; the dialogue is the response phase of the bodily-affliction scene.
units.counterevidence: Friends arrive in the same aftermath, but 2:11 introduces new named actors and coordinated travel.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate the second council's bounded permission.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: The three friends convene, fail to recognize Job, mourn, and sit silently seven days; Job speaks only at 3:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject merging with Job 3; non-speech closes the prose frame and 3:1 explicitly opens the poetic curse.
units.counterevidence: The silence directly occasions the lament, so the following lament sibling is mandatory.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate the trials and following opening lament.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job opens his mouth and curses his day; coordinated day-and-night imprecations run through the womb reason before why-questions start at 3:11.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject ending at 3:8 or isolating Leviathan; 3:9-10 complete the night curse and causal close.
units.counterevidence: The whole chapter is one lament, so both following movements must hydrate this child.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Repeated why-did-I-not-die questions develop an imagined burial-rest catalogue from kings to prisoners and end with small and great together.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject splits at 3:13 or 3:17; all classes answer one imagined-rest question.
units.counterevidence: Verse 20 continues why diction but shifts from counterfactual birth-death to present life given to sufferers.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: The question turns to why light and life reach the bitter, then narrows to Job's sighing, fears, unrest, and trouble before Eliphaz answers at 4:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject detaching 3:25-26; feared calamity is the personal culmination of the life-to-sufferers question.
units.counterevidence: Darkness and death diction binds this close to the prior lament movements.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate the whole lament and Eliphaz's response.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Eliphaz moves from hesitant address and Job's former counsel to a sowing-reaping claim and lion-collapse simile; 4:12 starts a revelation report.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject 4:7-11 as a free proverb; it answers the appeal to Job's confidence.
units.counterevidence: No new speaker at 4:12, so both units remain children of Eliphaz's whole speech.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate the night vision and conclusion.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: A stealthily received word, nocturnal dread, apparition, silence, and voiced question end in the mortality-of-clay-dwellers application.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject stopping at 4:17; 4:18-21 interprets the oracle through servant, angel, and clay-house contrasts.
units.counterevidence: The chapter boundary does not end Eliphaz's speech; 5:1 resumes exhortation from this anthropology.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: The call to a holy one, fool's fate, and human trouble turn at I-would-seek-God into a reversal hymn that gives the poor hope.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject splitting at 5:8; the recommendation answers the fool-and-trouble example.
units.counterevidence: Verse 17 opens a blessed-is maxim, though it continues the seek-God appeal.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Happy-is-the-corrected opens a beatitude; wound-and-heal and numbered deliverances lead to the explicit searched-it, hear-it close.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject atomizing sixfold promises or detaching 5:27; the attestation claims the whole sequence.
units.counterevidence: It can sound generic apart from Job, so speech and cycle parents are mandatory.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job weighs grief, names divine arrows, defends his cry through food images, and asks for death that would preserve his refusal to deny the Holy One; 6:14 turns to friendship.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject splitting at 6:8; the death wish completes the claim that his cry matches unbearable weight.
units.counterevidence: Food and strength images shift locally but remain one self-defense before addressing friends.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate Eliphaz and Job's continuing reply.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job states loyalty owed to the faint, develops the seasonal-wadi comparison, denies asking payment or rescue, and demands instruction and renewed just judgment.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject surfacing 6:24-30 alone; the demand answers the accusation within the wadi complaint.
units.counterevidence: Third-person caravans shift to second-person friends, but no new turn severs comparison from appeal.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job generalizes life as warfare and hired service, returns to allotted nights and bodily decay, and closes with wind, cloud, Sheol, and no-return imagery; 7:11 announces speech.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject detaching 7:6-10; the images complete the servant-night lament.
units.counterevidence: Chapter 7 remains the same reply, so direct complaint at 7:11-21 is required.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Therefore-I-will-not-keep-silent opens complaint; sea-monster guarding and dream terror lead to what-is-man questions and the sin, target, forgiveness, dust close.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject isolating 7:17-21; watcher language is Job's accusatory application of 7:11-16.
units.counterevidence: The shift at 7:17 is strong but is the climax of one address to God.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate Job's full reply and Bildad's answer.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Bildad rebukes wind-like words, asserts divine justice, applies it to the children, and conditionally urges Job to seek God for restoration.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject isolating 8:4 or 8:5-7; harsh application and exhortation are consecutive parts of his opening answer.
units.counterevidence: Verse 8 explicitly appeals to former generations, a stronger seam than internal conditions.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Ask-the-former-generation opens transmitted proof; papyrus, spider-web, and luxuriant-plant analogies culminate in God-will-not-cast-away and enemies' shame.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject splitting the analogies; together they warrant Bildad's final assurance.
units.counterevidence: Each analogy closes locally, but none carries the final application alone.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job says no person can be just in contest, then catalogs unanswerable power over mountains, earth, sun, stars, sea, and hidden passage, ending who-can-question.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject isolating 9:5-10 as a hymn; it gives the reason the forensic contest is impossible.
units.counterevidence: The hymn form is real but bears an adversarial legal function in Job's reply.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate legal and experiential consequences in 9:13-35.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Rahab intensifies divine non-withdrawal; Job imagines answering a judge, doubts being heard, describes storm-crushing, and ends with the land-in-wicked-hands challenge.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject division at 9:20; innocence, guilt, and world-order accusation arise from one impossible lawsuit.
units.counterevidence: Rare language and compressed syntax lower confidence but yield no better form seam.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Now-my-days introduces racing images, Job rejects self-cleansing because God would plunge him back, and he longs for an arbiter who could remove rod and fear.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject isolating 9:33; the arbiter answers the failed lawsuit and washing sequence.
units.counterevidence: Job's complaint continues into chapter 10, so this is a movement seam, not a new speech.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate prior forensic movements and Job 10.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: My-soul-is-weary opens sustained address asking why God contends, recalling hands, skin, bones, life, and favor, reinterpreting creation as pursuit, and pleading for comfort before darkness.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject chapter-internal primary children at 10:8 or 10:18; creation memory and birth-lament are evidence and climax of one lawsuit.
units.counterevidence: Creation, prosecution, and death-darkness are strophes, but repeated second-person address favors the whole.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Zophar rebukes many words, wishes God would expose hidden wisdom, asks measureless-depth questions, labels the witless, and conditionally promises security before contrasting wicked hope.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject 11:7-12 as an abstract hymn or 11:13-20 as generic advice; both advance Zophar's rebuke.
units.counterevidence: Three movements exist, but this compact named turn is distorted when detached.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job mocks monopoly on wisdom, names himself a righteous laughingstock amid secure robbers, and summons animals, earth, and fish to teach that Yahweh's hand holds life.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject splitting at 12:7; creature testimony counters the friends' supposedly obvious wisdom.
units.counterevidence: Verse 12 can introduce the next catalogue but also closes the polemic against inherited authority.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: With-God-are-wisdom-and-might opens parallel reversals: breaking, withholding, releasing, stripping, silencing, overturning, exposing, enlarging, and making leaders wander.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject chunks by social class or action; the pairs form one comprehensive challenge to conventional order.
units.counterevidence: Hymn-like form is real, but its destabilizing force belongs to Job's dispute.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job claims equal knowledge, declares desire to reason with the Almighty, indicts friends as forgers and partial advocates, and reduces their maxims and defenses to ashes and clay.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject 13:7-12 as a generic warning; it supports Job's demand to bypass friends and litigate with God.
units.counterevidence: Job 13 continues, but 13:13 marks a sharp silence-command and risk pivot.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Let-me-alone opens readiness to risk his flesh; Job asserts presenting the case as hope, asks two conditions, summons charge or answer, and requests disclosed sins rather than enemy treatment.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject isolating 13:15 or 13:20-23; hope and the two-condition petition are phases of one hearing.
units.counterevidence: Translation uncertainty at 13:15 lowers semantic confidence, but legal architecture is stable.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Born-of-woman opens flower-shadow brevity and impurity, moves through fixed days and rest, then contrasts a felled tree's hope with a human lying down until heavens cease.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject separating 14:7-12 as nature proverb; the tree sharpens the plea about finite days.
units.counterevidence: The tree is a clear subform but ends in the human-death impasse answered by 14:13.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Oh-that-you-would-hide-me opens hoped-for remembrance and renewed summons, but mountain erosion and washed soil reverse hope before isolated pain closes the reply.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject 14:14-17 as settled doctrine; hoped renewal is immediately countered by 14:18-22.
units.counterevidence: Wish and erosion pull opposite ways, yet their tension is the coherent close.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate the whole reply and first cycle.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Eliphaz attacks windy knowledge, claims Job's speech destroys piety, and makes Job's mouth the condemning witness; 15:7 begins a firstborn-wisdom taunt.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject merging with 15:7-16; effect-of-speech gives way to privileged-wisdom dispute.
units.counterevidence: Both are accusatory questions in one turn and need the full speech parent.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Firstborn and council questions challenge Job's privilege, appeal to aged tradition, and culminate in heavens-not-clean and abominable-human comparisons.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject detaching 15:14-16; it warrants denying Job exceptional standing.
units.counterevidence: The ancient-men appeal could link forward, but I-will-show-you at 15:17 is the cleaner seam.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: I-will-show-you opens ancestral testimony; dread, siege, defiance, doomed wealth, darkness, fire, vanity, and barren-company images culminate in deceit.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject splitting at 15:25; defiance explains why the same sufferer in 17-24 meets the end in 25-35.
units.counterevidence: Torment-to-cause is a real shift, but one portrait preserves Eliphaz's polemical application.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job names them miserable comforters, asks what provokes their answers, and imagines how he could speak and console if positions reversed.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject merging into 16:6-17; counterfactual friend-speech closes before Job resumes unavoidable anguish.
units.counterevidence: This brief exordium cannot stand without Job's full 16:1-17:16 reply.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Speaking or silence cannot ease grief; God appears as shriveling witness, beast, archer, and warrior while people gape and strike, ending despite no violence and pure prayer.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject split at 16:10; hostile humans are embedded in Job's portrayal of being delivered and shattered.
units.counterevidence: The innocence assertion anticipates 16:18-22 but also closes the assault's scandal.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job asks earth not to cover his blood, asserts a witness and advocate in heaven, describes tearful pleading, and ends with the few-years no-return horizon.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject isolating 16:19-21; uncovered blood summons the witness and death gives urgency.
units.counterevidence: Job 17 repeats death imminence, so this is a dependent legal-lament child.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Broken spirit and ready grave open; Job asks God for a pledge, contrasts mockery with upright perseverance, then gathers plans, light, hope, and family into descent to Sheol.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject detaching 17:11-16; vanished plans answer the pledge-and-mockery crisis.
units.counterevidence: Pledge and hope-descent are strophes, but the grave inclusio favors one unit.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Bildad rebukes Job, then one portrait extinguishes light, ensnares feet, consumes body, uproots tent, and erases descendants and memory before these-are-the-dwellings closes.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject separating trap, terror, disease, and memory; their escalation is Bildad's single implied identification of Job.
units.counterevidence: Imagery resets at 18:11 and 18:17, but the compact named speech and demonstrative close outweigh them.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job asks how long friends will crush him, counts reproaches, distinguishes private error, and concludes God has overthrown and netted him.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject ending at 19:5; verse 6 names the action grounding the siege at 19:7.
units.counterevidence: Verse 6 also introduces 19:7-12, making this a hydrated moderate seam.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job cries unanswered; God fences road, darkens, strips glory, breaks him like a tree, kindles wrath, and sends troops around his tent.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject microchunks by image; all expand the net announced at 19:6.
units.counterevidence: Verse 13 lacks a speaker reset but shifts agent from God and troops to estranged humans.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Brothers, acquaintances, relatives, guests, servants, wife, children, and friends reject Job; twice-asked pity closes because God's hand struck him.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject splitting social groups or isolating pity; the list supplies audience and cause.
units.counterevidence: Verse 23 starts an inscription wish while continuing the search for witness beyond failed companions.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Oh-that-my-words-were-written opens inscription; Job asserts a living redeemer and seeing language, then warns friends their pursuit faces the sword.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject isolating 19:25-27; inscription, witness, longing, and warning are one legal close.
units.counterevidence: Hebrew and translations of 25-27 are difficult and the warning shifts addressee, lowering interpretation confidence while the unit stays secure.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate abandonment and cycle; never detach as a doctrinal proof text.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Zophar answers from agitation, invokes understanding, and states the ancient thesis that wicked triumph and godless joy are brief.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject hiding the thesis inside 20:6 onward; the opening frames the portrait.
units.counterevidence: It is only an exordium and needs the full 20:1-29 parent.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: The wicked rise to heaven and vanish; youthful vigor reaches dust, mouth-sweet evil becomes poison, and swallowed riches are vomited, ending with labor not enjoyed.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject splitting at 20:12; disappearance and poisoned consumption jointly prove brief triumph.
units.counterevidence: Verse 19 supplies causal oppression, a plausible transition from fate to grounds and judgment.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Because-he-oppressed supplies the charge; restless appetite, distress, arrow, fire, exposure, and swept-away house culminate in this-is-the-portion-from-God.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject detaching 20:29; it explicitly sums the catalogue.
units.counterevidence: Multiple weapon images occur, but indictment and inheritance formula bind one judicial result.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate Zophar's thesis and Job's countercase.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job commands attentive hearing as consolation, asks patience before mockery, and presents his human-directed complaint as terror that makes him tremble.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject merging with evidence at 21:7; the opening establishes audience and stakes.
units.counterevidence: Content is incomplete without 21:7-34 and needs the speech parent.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Why-do-the-wicked-live opens established offspring, safe houses, fertile livestock, music, pleasure, peaceful death, and their command that God depart because prayer profits nothing.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject isolating 21:14-15; it is the posture of the prosperous wicked just described.
units.counterevidence: Verse 16 disclaims their counsel and could open response, but its refrain closes the portrait.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate how-often questions and final challenge.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Repeated how-often questions challenge immediate retribution, demand personal recompense, and contrast one dying at ease with another bitter though both lie in dust.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject split at 21:23; paired deaths answer the retribution questions.
units.counterevidence: Who-shall-teach-God at 21:22 could close the first half, but equal-grave contrast completes it.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Behold-I-know-your-thoughts opens exposure of the vanished-prince proof; traveler testimony about spared wicked, public burial, and followers ends with their answers false.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject detaching 21:29-33; testimony answers the friends' question and warrants the verdict.
units.counterevidence: Burial continues equal-dust imagery, but direct second-person framing marks the closing rebuttal.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate the full speech and cycle.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Eliphaz denies human benefit to God, invents abuses of debtors, hungry, widows, and orphans, then links darkness to the old path of suddenly cut-off wicked people.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject split at 22:12; high-heaven questions and old-path warning interpret the consequences of accusations.
units.counterevidence: Indictment and old-path example differ, but 22:21 begins the unmistakable reconcile-now appeal.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Acquaint-yourself-now opens imperatives to receive, return, remove injustice, and treasure God; promised delight, prayer, light, deliverance, and intercession close.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject isolating 22:28 or 22:30; declaration and deliverance are conditional outcomes of demanded return.
units.counterevidence: Imperatives and promises are movements but condition-result structure favors one appeal.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job wishes to find God's seat and order his case; confidence in reasoning yields to directional search, then God-knows-my-path and treasured-command claims.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject detaching 23:8-12; hiddenness, tested path, and words answer the failed tribunal search.
units.counterevidence: Verse 10 sounds proverbial only if severed from absence and lawsuit.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: But-he-stands-alone pivots from Job's fidelity to God's unchangeable resolve; appointed acts produce terror, faint heart, and darkness that has not silenced him.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject merging through 24:1; a new why-question about unobserved judgment times resets the argument.
units.counterevidence: Darkness links to nighttime crimes in 24:13-17, but 24:1 is stronger.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate tribunal search and chapter 24 injustice.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Why-are-judgment-times-not-seen opens boundary theft, seized flocks, orphaned animals, displaced poor, gleaning, naked exposure, oil and wine labor, and city groans.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject rural-urban split; both accumulate evidence for delayed judgment.
units.counterevidence: Verse 12 is difficult but remains the catalogue's evaluative close.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Those-who-rebel-against-light introduces murderer, adulterer, and thief keyed to dawn, twilight, disguise, darkness, and death-shadow as morning.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject separating three offenders; temporal and light-darkness repetition makes one triptych.
units.counterevidence: It continues oppression evidence, but the light motif gives a dependent surface.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: The discourse abruptly shifts to swift waters, cursed inheritance, heat and snow, womb forgetting, broken tree, temporary exaltation, and cut grain before who-will-prove-me-false closes.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject reassigning to a missing speaker or moving it; the extant formula gives Job the turn and 24:25 closes it.
units.counterevidence: Apparent rapid retribution conflicts with 24:1-17 and compressed Hebrew leaves quotation or countervoice unresolved.
units.human_or_external_ai_question: Should Job.24.18-Job.24.25 remain a separately retrievable but obligatorily hydrated close of Job's extant reply, or should only Job.23.1-Job.24.25 surface until its rhetorical voice is resolved?

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Bildad's compact answer moves from dominion and armies to how-can-human-be-righteous questions and worm imagery.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject attaching to Job 26 or splitting cosmic and human comparisons; the named formula and six-verse closure are complete.
units.counterevidence: Brevity signals a disrupted cycle but cannot authorize supplying missing material.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate Job's 26:1 answer and incomplete-cycle context.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job mocks Bildad's help, asks whose breath spoke, then depicts shades, Sheol, suspended earth, clouds, horizon, pillars, sea, Rahab, heavens, serpent, and the whisper of God's ways.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject detaching 26:5-14 or reassigning it; Job-answered governs the extant turn.
units.counterevidence: Rebuke and hymn are different subforms, and placement theories exist, but no speaker reset outweighs the formula.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate Bildad and Job's renewed discourse.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job-again-took-up-his-discourse explicitly resets; as-God-lives opens an oath naming denied justice and vowing no wicked speech or surrendered integrity while breath remains.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject merging backward into Job 26; renewed-discourse formula marks a new movement.
units.counterevidence: The oath extends toward 27:7, but verse 7 shifts from self-assertion to opponents.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Let-my-enemy-be-as-wicked turns outward; questions about godless hope and answered cry lead to Job's promise to teach God's hand and rebuke the friends' vanity.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject isolating 27:11-12; it closes enemy challenge and opens the fate portrait.
units.counterevidence: Teach-you could belong with 27:13-23, so this is a dependent rhetorical division.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate integrity oath and wicked-person portion.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: This-is-the-portion-of-a-wicked-man announces descendants to sword and famine, widow silence, transferred riches, fragile house, sudden terrors, east wind, and removal.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject reassigning to Zophar to regularize the cycle; renewed Job-discourse is the extant attribution.
units.counterevidence: Content resembles friends' portraits and strains 27:1-12, lowering confidence without licensing fabrication.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Mining in 1-11, twice-asked where-is-wisdom and value comparison in 12-22, and God's unique knowledge in 23-28 form a whole ending with the fear saying.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject forced speaker identity or independent primary strophes; internal markers show movements, but question and answer bind the poem.
units.counterevidence: No new formula can favor Job continuity, while detached voice and book-level function can favor narrator or interlude treatment.
evidence_refs: OSHB x-pe after Job.28.11 and Job.28.19 and x-samekh after Job.28.28
units.hydration_requirement: Surface only with speaker ambiguity and Job 27 and 29 hydration.
units.human_or_external_ai_question: Should Job.28.1-Job.28.28 be independently retrievable as a whole speaker-ambiguous interlude with Job 27 and 29 hydration, or remain only in the larger Job.27.1-Job.31.40 context?

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Job-again-took-up-his-discourse resets; former months recall divine watching, lamp, counsel, children, abundance, and public deference from youths, elders, princes, and nobles.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject merging backward into Job 28 or starting at 29:7; the formula and favor memory frame all former honor.
units.counterevidence: Verse 7 narrows household blessing to gate status, but both serve one how-I-was-before lament.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Ear and eye testimony bless Job because he delivered poor, fatherless, dying, widow, blind, lame, needy, stranger, and prey; justice clothing ends in broken wicked jaws.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject dividing beneficiary register; each class substantiates Job's judicial identity.
units.counterevidence: Clothing can link to honor, but repeated because and rescue actions form a coherent exhibit.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate former honor and expected future.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Then-I-said introduces expected longevity, rooted vitality, renewed glory and bow; hearers wait for counsel like rain and Job sits as chief and comforter.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject isolating 29:18 as promise; it opens expectations now overturned and is translation-sensitive.
units.counterevidence: Verse 21 begins a counsel scene, but both complete the former-state portrait before now-they-mock.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: But-now reverses Job 29: younger outcasts become song-makers who spit and attack; their path-breaking assault becomes terrors that pursue honor and prosperity like wind and cloud.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject split at 30:9 or mocker microchunks; changed status, taunt, and attack are one public-humiliation reversal.
units.counterevidence: Genealogy and active attack differ, but but-now frame and honor collapse bind them.
units.hydration_requirement: Hydrate former honor and internal suffering.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Now-my-soul-is-poured-out turns inward to seized affliction and bone-gnawing night, then accuses God of silence, cruel tossing, dissolution, and bringing him to death.
units.rejected_alternative: Reject detaching 30:20-23; direct address is the agent-focused climax of bodily suffering.
units.counterevidence: The lament continues, but 30:24 starts a protested expectation of help.

units.counterevidence: Dream and suffering cases differ and 23-30 is difficult, but Elihu gathers them as repeated divine speech.

units.deciding_seam_or_marker: Moreover-Elihu-answered renews speech, addresses wise hearers, quotes Job's justice and no-profit claims, and rejects divine wickedness through repayment, world rule, and spirit-breath dependence.
